# Kahvi

Coffee: roasted beans, ground, met with hot water. Brewing it every morning
is the procedure in [Kahvin keitto](../skills/kahvin-keitto.md), written
down [one evening](../journals/2026-07-02.md); the idea dates from
[June](../journals/archive/2026/06/2026-06-30.md), and the whole
[July journal](../journals/archive/2026/07/2026-07-01.md) tells the rest.
